<article title="Order tracking">
You can follow your order from the Orders page of your account. Once a package leaves our warehouse, the order shows a carrier name and a tracking number, and the carrier's page updates within 24 hours of the first scan.

If the tracking page has not updated for more than three business days, the package may be delayed at a carrier hub. In that case we can open a trace with the carrier; a trace usually resolves within five business days.

Orders placed before 2 pm on a business day leave the warehouse the same day. Orders placed later, or on weekends, leave the next business day.

</article>

Customer first name: Victor
<request>
tracking number does not work
the tracking number in my confirmation email is not recognized by the carrier website.
</request>

Reply:
text:
Hi Victor,

Thanks for reaching out. According to our tracking information, tracking numbers typically appear in your account's Orders page once your package leaves our warehouse. The carrier's system usually updates within 24 hours of the first scan.

If your tracking number isn't being recognized by the carrier yet, it may not have been scanned into their system. A specialist will follow up with you shortly to investigate further and help resolve this issue.

Fernwood Outfitters Support
